# authwise_access_binding (Data Source)

A binding that grants a subject a role in an audience's Access catalog. This data source reads one by its full resource name.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Full resource name of the object to read.

### Read-Only

- `access_binding_id` (String) Server-assigned resource id — the last segment of `name`, and what other resources' `*_id` attributes take.
- `audience_id` (String)
- `condition_id` (String)
- `created_by` (String)
- `expires_at` (String)
- `issuer_id` (String)
- `resource_id` (String)
- `resource_type` (String)
- `role_name` (String)
- `subject_id` (String)
- `subject_type` (String)
- `tenant_id` (String)
